nurse.text: Hiya, chuck! Welcome to Blackpool Sanctuary. Pop your team on the counter. They look like they've been on the Big One twice.
What can we do for you?

then.text: There we are. A nice cup of tea, a stick of rock for the shock, and a sit-down out of the wind.
All better! Fit as a lop, as my nan used to say. Nobody knows what a lop is. Off you go, love.
The Ark's in the corner, chuck. Somebody's stuck a kiss-me-quick sticker on the lid. It wasn't me.

else.text: Ta-ra, love! Mind the trams, they don't stop for anyone.
